rules.finding: First action sets caller out character=null. The only later out stores follow successful newobj and lead to true, never an ordinary false branch. Therefore ordinary false leaves out null and ordinary true leaves constructed nonnull character, conditional on normal completion and underlying call semantics. Exceptions are different: out/list/dictionary/native mutations may already have happened. No out reference is passed to helpers; glyph-add receives a distinct local glyph reference. This closes phase103 false-with-nonnull hypothetical for these normal returns; includeFallbacks/set/list/recursion limits remain unchanged.

Alias glyph selection preserves ORIGINAL Unicode in constructed character and character dictionary. No scalar validation, atlas-mode guard or definition initialization here; collections/font/texture null and array bounds are not guarded. Native face selection and missing-set effects are separate.

No null glyph guard before setter/constructor. Success before late failure can leave partial mutations; settings/registration bodies unread.

First failed attempt enters one conditional multi-atlas retry: if flag false return false; otherwise call exact unread SetupNewAtlasTexture, then repeat add using post-call current index/fields. If second call false, false; no retry loop/rollback here. If true repeat ordered glyph/character/list/feature actions. Setup mutations may survive second failure, but its exact mutation contract remains unread. No check that new atlas index differs or returned glyph valid; native behavior is not inferred.
